Before you order

Before you order.

Useful information for your first ORVELLA order.

Are all the perfumes currently available?

Availability is confirmed directly before payment. Catalogue quantities are not live inventory. Until ORVELLA checks the current stock, each perfume is marked Confirm availability. Adding to your bag does not reserve a bottle.

Is delivery included in the price?

No. The displayed price is for the perfume. Delivery is charged separately and confirmed using your location before you pay.

Does adding a bottle to my bag reserve it?

No. A bottle is only reserved after ORVELLA confirms the order directly. Adding an item to your bag or saved collection does not hold stock.

Do I pay on the website?

No payment is collected here. Your bag creates a WhatsApp order enquiry. Availability, the final total and official payment details are confirmed directly by ORVELLA.

How do I avoid paying the wrong account?

Only use payment details sent through the official ORVELLA contact after your order has been confirmed. The WhatsApp number shown on this website is +233 53 414 2445.

What are the return and exchange conditions?

Please contact ORVELLA to confirm the return and exchange conditions before placing an order. No specific return period has been published on this website.

A clear shopping experience

Your bag.
Your browser.

This website saves your order bag and favourite perfumes in your browser’s local storage, where available. These selections remain on this device until you remove them or clear browser storage.

Your name and delivery area are optional. They stay in this page’s memory and are added only to the message you choose to send on WhatsApp. They are not saved by this website after you refresh.

No card details or payment are collected by this website. Product photos load from external websites, which receive normal image requests. WhatsApp and your hosting provider operate under their own privacy policies.

Listed quantities are a catalogue snapshot, not a live stock system. Prices and availability are confirmed directly before payment.

Your scent-match answers stay in this page’s memory.

When a link contains a campaign code, this website remembers that code in this tab’s session storage and includes it in an enquiry you choose to send. This helps ORVELLA know which post you used. No analytics service or advertising pixel is installed. Your hosting provider and WhatsApp may process data under their own policies.
